caption: The drawing, rendered in black pencil or ink on a sepia-toned paper, depicts two views of the same dress, shown on headless mannequins. In the foreground, a large, detailed front view of the dress is featured. The dress is long and flowing, with multiple vertical folds suggesting a loose and draped fabric. The neckline is square and decorated with a delicate lace or embroidered trim, as are the edges of the short, wide, ruffled sleeves. The bodice is gathered just below the neckline and tied at the center with a small ribbon or string. To the right, a smaller sketch presents the back view of the same dress, revealing the gathered bodice and lace trim continuing around the upper edge and sleeves. The entire composition is neatly outlined with minimal shading, focusing on the garment’s structure and decorative features, against a plain, unadorned background.
title: Shift
